metadata.name: kumaoni
metadata.description: Standard Python library for Kumaoni language processing, morphology, universal translation, linguistics, and Himalayan oral culture.

quickstart.code:
import kumaoni
# 1. Translation result = kumaoni.translate("Where are you going?", source="en", target="kumaoni") print(result.text) # Devanagari output print(result.romanized) # Romanized phonetic output
# 2. Dictionary & 300k+ Morphology Lemmatizer word = kumaoni.lookup("काफल") lemma = kumaoni.lemmatize("खान्छू") # -> 'खाण' analysis = kumaoni.analyze("घरबटि") # -> Lemma: घर, POS: noun, Case: ablative
# 3. Verb Conjugation verb = kumaoni.conjugate("जाण", tense="past", person=1) # -> 'ग्यूँ'
# 4. Numbers & Fractions words = kumaoni.num_to_words(108) # -> 'एक सौ आठ' frac = kumaoni.fraction(0.5) # -> 'आधो'
# 5. Culture & Folklore proverb = kumaoni.proverbs.random() epic = kumaoni.literature.get_epic("malushahi")

module.name: kumaoni.translator
module.description: Multi-engine translation system for English, Hindi, and 100+ world languages to/from Kumaoni.

function.name: kumaoni.translate
function.signature: (text: str, source: str = "en", target: str = "kumaoni", method: str = "auto") -> TranslationResult
function.description: Translates text into Kumaoni with .text (Devanagari) and .romanized attributes.

function.name: kumaoni.voice_translate
function.signature: (text: str, source_lang: str = "auto", method: str = "auto", generate_audio: bool = False) -> VoiceTranslationResult
function.description: Translates text and provides IPA phonetics and optional synthetic WAV audio.

module.name: kumaoni.lexicon
module.description: 1,355+ authenticated lemmas and 300,000+ indexed inflected morphological forms.

function.name: kumaoni.lookup
function.description: Searches base dictionary definitions across Kumaoni, English, and Hindi.

function.name: kumaoni.search
function.description: Multi-result substring and fuzzy search in vocabulary database.

function.name: kumaoni.lemmatize
function.description: Reduces inflected surface forms (e.g. खान्छू, घरबटि) to base dictionary lemma (खाण, घर).

function.name: kumaoni.analyze
function.description: Provides full grammatical tag breakdown (POS, Tense, Person, Number, Gender, Case).

function.name: kumaoni.total_word_forms
function.description: Returns total count of generated and indexed full-form morphological paradigms (300,000+).

module.name: kumaoni.grammar
module.description: Linguistic rules for SOV sentence structure, verb conjugations, modals, and noun declensions.

function.name: kumaoni.conjugate
function.signature: (verb: str, tense: str = "present", person: int = 1, number: str = "sg", gender: str = "m", honorific: bool = False) -> str
function.description: Conjugates regular and irregular verbs (जाण, खाण, करन, इत्यादी) across tenses.

function.name: kumaoni.conjugate_to_be
function.signature: (tense: str = "present", person: int = 1, number: str = "sg", gender: str = "m") -> str
function.description: Conjugates substantive auxiliary verb (छ- / to be).

function.name: kumaoni.build_sentence
function.signature: (subject: str, verb: str, obj: str = "", tense: str = "present", ...) -> str
function.description: Constructs full grammatically aligned Kumaoni SOV sentences.

function.name: kumaoni.imperative
function.signature: (verb: str, person: int = 2, honorific: bool = False, plural: bool = False) -> str
function.description: Generates imperative command forms.

function.name: kumaoni.causative
function.description: Generates 1st (खवाण) and 2nd degree (खववाण) causative verbs.

function.name: kumaoni.passive
function.description: Generates passive voice forms.

function.name: kumaoni.decline_noun
function.signature: (noun: str, case: str, number: str = "sg", gender: str = "m") -> str
function.description: Declines nouns into cases: nominative, accusative, ergative, instrumental, dative, ablative, genitive, locative.

function.name: kumaoni.get_marker
function.description: Returns authentic Kumaoni case postpositions (-ले, -कणी, -बटि, -म, -क/कि/का).

function.name: kumaoni.get_pronoun
function.signature: (person: int, number: str = "sg", case: str = "direct", gender: str = "m", honorific: bool = False) -> str
function.description: Returns personal and demonstrative pronouns (मैं, तू, तम/तुम, ऊ, हम, ऊँ).

function.name: kumaoni.echo_word
function.description: Generates authentic hill reduplicative echo words (e.g. भात-व़ात, किताब-सिताब).

module.name: kumaoni.numbers
module.description: Number to words converter, Devanagari numerals, customary fractions, and ordinals.

function.name: kumaoni.num_to_words
function.description: Converts integers (0 to 1,000,000,000+) to Kumaoni words.

function.name: kumaoni.words_to_num
function.description: Parses Kumaoni written number words back to integer.

function.name: kumaoni.to_devanagari_numerals
function.description: Converts number into Devanagari digits (०१२३४५६७८९).

function.name: kumaoni.fraction
function.description: Returns traditional fractions: आधो (0.5), पाव (0.25), पौण (0.75), सवा (1.25), डेढ़ (1.5), ढाई (2.5).

function.name: kumaoni.ordinal
function.description: Returns ordinal words: पैलो (1st), दुसर (2nd), तेसर (3rd), चौथ (4th).

module.name: kumaoni.phonetics
module.description: Devanagari to Latin phonetic transliteration and script normalizer.

function.name: kumaoni.transliterate
function.description: Two-way transliteration between Devanagari and Latin Romanized scripts.

function.name: kumaoni.normalize
function.description: Normalizes Devanagari Unicode characters, halants, and nuktas.

function.name: kumaoni.detect_script
function.description: Detects if string is 'devanagari', 'latin', or 'mixed'.

module.name: kumaoni.culture
module.description: Oral literature, epics, folklore, canonical poetry, scholars, solar calendar, and festivals.

facade.name: kumaoni.proverbs
facade.description: 45+ authentic proverbs (Akhaan) with literal and figurative meanings.

facade.name: kumaoni.riddles
facade.description: 20+ traditional riddles (Aana) with answers and hints.

facade.name: kumaoni.phrases
facade.description: 75+ everyday conversational idioms, blessings, and idioms.

facade.name: kumaoni.festivals
facade.description: Harela, Phool Dei, Ghughutiya, Olgia, Nanda Devi, Bagwal.

facade.name: kumaoni.literature
facade.description: Epics (Malushahi-Rajula, Jiya Rani, Golu Devta, Haru Singh Heet), 15+ Scholars (Badri Datt Pande, Gumani, Gaurda).
